# Abstract {.unnumbered .unlisted}

The abstract (if required) summarizes the presentation of the problem, the
method(s) used and the most important result on about 1/2 to 1 page.

You can find out how to write a successful abstract in the seminars or by
consulting the Center for Soft Skills Development[^schreibzentrum].

Key words/key phrases: if necessary, provide 3 to 10 key words.

[^schreibzentrum]: <https://www.th-koeln.de/schreibzentrum>
